jobs.title: Silicon Operations Manager
jobs.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do Arago designs its own SoCs. As Silicon Operations Manager, you will own everything after design, from foundry handoff to volume production. You pick up the chip once front-end and physical design are done, and you are accountable for getting working parts in volume. That means managing the foundry, OSAT partners, and test house; co-designing the package; driving qualification and yield ramp; and owning cost, schedule, and supplier relationships. This is not a coordinator role. You are the technical owner of the path from tapeout to shipped product. Required Skills and Experience 7+ years in semiconductor back-end / NPI, with at least one chip taken to production in a fabless context as the main contact with OSATs and foundries. Direct experience managing OSATs and foundries (e.g. TSMC, GF, Samsung, Amkor, ASE). Solid knowledge of advanced packaging: flip-chip, FCBGA, substrates, and package/die co-design. ATE test and wafer sort experience, plus so

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Business Operations
jobs.description: At Joko, our mission is to help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 130 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 🔥 Our Business Operations Team At Joko, the Business Operations team is the powerhouse behind internal innovation. We tackle the company’s most strategic and complex challenges, and we don’t just solve them—we turn them into long-term, scalable growth engines. Whether it’s launching entirely new business lines, rethinking revenue infrastructure, or embedding AI into our operations, we lead high-impact initiatives that push Joko forward faster, smarter, and stronger. Our mission: Help Joko operate at its absolute best, every single day. Three sub-teams bring this mission to life: 💼 Business: helping business teams work smarter through better processes and automation. 🧚 Team: building the internal tools and workflows that make life at Joko simpler. 🔐 Security & Compliance: protecting the trust that powers our growth. Whichever sub-team you join, you’ll have the opportunity to build, experiment, and make a tangible difference in how Joko works. jobs.title: Founding Product Builder, Operations
jobs.description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software. This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else. We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast. Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we'll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone. The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows. We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. jobs.title: (Senior) Logistics Lead - 3PL Management
jobs.description: Position Overview Axelera AI builds the hardware that brings AI to the edge, and our chips, boards and systems are shipping to customers around the world. Every evaluation kit, sample and production order needs to arrive on time, intact and fully compliant. As our (Senior) Logistics Lead, you will own these logistics at Axelera end to end. You will lead the relationship with our global 3PL partner, from business reviews and KPI management to speaking up when something goes wrong. At the same time, you will stay hands-on: receiving, kitting and dispatching goods for our R&D, test and lab teams. You will have the mandate to shape how logistics works at Axelera and to build processes and systems that scale with our growth. Location: Eindhoven, Netherlands. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI REMOTE, United States JOB OVERVIEW Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it. Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there. You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it. Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not. The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. jobs.description: Growth at CFO Insights Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights. The mission: build the world s largest network for private equity investors. You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel. If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply. Why CFO Insights CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow s innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. jobs.title: Senior RWE Program Manager - Data/IA Expert

Préparer et animer les instances de gouvernance ainsi que le reporting auprès des parties prenantes senior. Favoriser la collaboration entre des équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales. Veiller à l'adoption des meilleures pratique
